title: John Chapter 14 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on John chapter 14 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: John Chapter 14 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of John Chapter 14.

questions.question: In John 14, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Let not your heart be troubled
In my Father's house are many mansions
questions.correctAnswer: Let not your heart be troubled
questions.explanation: This phrase appears first in the chapter, as stated in John 14:1.

questions.question: What does Jesus say He is in John 14:6?
options: The way, the truth, and the life
questions.correctAnswer: The way, the truth, and the life
questions.explanation: Jesus identifies Himself as 'the way, the truth, and the life' in John 14:6.

questions.question: What promise does Jesus give in John 14:3?
options: I will teach you all things
questions.correctAnswer: I will come again
questions.explanation: In John 14:3, Jesus promises, 'I will come again, and receive you unto myself.'

questions.question: According to John 14:2, what is in the Father's house?
questions.correctAnswer: Many mansions
questions.explanation: John 14:2 states, 'In my Father's house are many mansions.'

questions.question: What did Thomas say to Jesus in John 14:5?
options: Lord, we know not whither thou goest
questions.correctAnswer: Lord, we know not whither thou goest
questions.explanation: In John 14:5, Thomas expresses uncertainty by saying, 'Lord, we know not whither thou goest.'

questions.question: What does Jesus say about knowing the Father in John 14:7?
options: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also
questions.correctAnswer: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also
questions.explanation: John 14:7 states, 'If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.'

questions.question: What question does Philip ask Jesus in John 14:8?
options: How can we know the way?
Show us the Father, and it sufficeth us
questions.correctAnswer: Show us the Father, and it sufficeth us
questions.explanation: Philip requests, 'Show us the Father, and it sufficeth us' in John 14:8.

questions.question: What does Jesus imply about seeing Him in John 14:9?
options: He who has seen Him has seen the Father
He is the way to the Father
He is the light of the world
questions.correctAnswer: He who has seen Him has seen the Father
questions.explanation: In John 14:9, Jesus states, 'He that hath seen me hath seen the Father.'

questions.question: What does Jesus say about the works He does in John 14:10?
options: They are for the glory of man
questions.correctAnswer: The Father doeth the works
questions.explanation: John 14:10 mentions, 'the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.'

questions.question: What does Jesus ask His disciples in John 14:11?
options: Believe me that I am in the Father
questions.correctAnswer: Believe me that I am in the Father
questions.explanation: In John 14:11, Jesus asks, 'Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me.'

questions.question: In John 14:6, who does Jesus say can come to the Father?
questions.correctAnswer: Only through Him
questions.explanation: John 14:6 states, 'no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.'

questions.question: Is it true that Jesus promised to prepare a place for His followers?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: This is true as stated in John 14:2, where Jesus mentions going to prepare a place for them.

questions.question: Is it true that Thomas knew the way to where Jesus was going?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: This is false; Thomas expressed uncertainty in John 14:5, stating, 'we know not whither thou goest.'

questions.question: Is it true that Philip asked Jesus to show him the way?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: This is false; Philip asked Jesus to show them the Father, not the way, as recorded in John 14:8.

questions.question: Is it true that Jesus said He is the light of the world in John 14?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: This is false; in John 14, Jesus identifies Himself as 'the way, the truth, and the life,' not as 'the light of the world.'

medium.title: John Chapter 14 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from John Chapter 14 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What will those who believe in Jesus do according to John 14:12?
options: They shall do the works that He does
They shall not do any works
They shall go to the Father
questions.correctAnswer: They shall do the works that He does
questions.explanation: This is correct as John 14:12 states that those who believe in Jesus will do the works He does.

questions.question: What does John 14:13 promise will happen if someone asks in Jesus' name?
questions.correctAnswer: He will do it
questions.explanation: According to John 14:13, Jesus promises to do whatever is asked in His name.

questions.question: What is the condition for Jesus to do what is asked in His name according to John 14:14?
options: If you ask with a pure heart
If you ask any thing in my name
questions.correctAnswer: If you ask any thing in my name
questions.explanation: John 14:14 states that if one asks anything in Jesus' name, He will do it.

questions.question: What does John 14:15 command believers to do if they love Jesus?
questions.correctAnswer: Keep my commandments
questions.explanation: John 14:15 emphasizes that love for Jesus is shown through obedience to His commandments.

questions.question: What is promised in John 14:16 if one keeps Jesus' commandments?
options: You will not see the Father
questions.correctAnswer: Another Comforter will be given
questions.explanation: According to John 14:16, Jesus promises to pray to the Father to send another Comforter for those who keep His commandments.

questions.question: According to John 14:17, why can the world not receive the Spirit of truth?
options: Because it does not want Him
questions.correctAnswer: Because it knows Him not
questions.explanation: John 14:17 explains that the world cannot receive the Spirit of truth because it does not see or know Him.

questions.question: What assurance does Jesus give in John 14:18 to His disciples?
questions.correctAnswer: He will come to them
questions.explanation: In John 14:18, Jesus assures His disciples that He will not leave them comfortless and will come to them.

questions.question: What does John 14:20 reveal about the relationship between Jesus, the Father, and believers?
options: They are only with the righteous
They do not know each other
questions.correctAnswer: They are in each other
questions.explanation: John 14:20 indicates that Jesus is in the Father, and believers are in Him, showing a deep unity.

questions.question: According to John 14:21, who truly loves Jesus?
questions.correctAnswer: He who keeps His commandments
questions.explanation: John 14:21 states that the one who loves Jesus is the one who has and keeps His commandments.

questions.question: What question does Judas (not Iscariot) ask in John 14:22?
options: How will you manifest yourself to us?
Why do you speak in parables?
questions.correctAnswer: How will you manifest yourself to us?
questions.explanation: In John 14:22, Judas asks Jesus how He will manifest Himself to them but not to the world.

questions.question: If believers keep Jesus’ commandments, what will they receive according to John 14:21?
options: They will be loved by the Father
questions.correctAnswer: They will be loved by the Father
questions.explanation: John 14:21 states that those who love Jesus by keeping His commandments will be loved by the Father.

questions.question: What does John 14:19 say about the relationship between Jesus' life and believers' lives?
options: If He lives, they will die
If He lives, they shall live also
questions.correctAnswer: If He lives, they shall live also
questions.explanation: John 14:19 states that because Jesus lives, believers will also have life.

questions.question: True or False: According to John 14:15, loving Jesus is shown through keeping His commandments.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: This statement is true as John 14:15 explicitly states that keeping His commandments is a sign of love for Him.

questions.question: True or False: According to John 14:13, asking in Jesus' name guarantees that the Father will not be glorified.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: This statement is false because John 14:13 states that asking in Jesus' name will glorify the Father.

questions.question: True or False: John 14:16 states that the Comforter will only abide with believers temporarily.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: This statement is false as John 14:16 indicates that the Comforter will abide with believers forever.

hard.title: John Chapter 14 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from John Chapter 14.

questions.question: According to John 14:23, what happens if a man loves Jesus?
options: He will keep my words and my Father will love him
He will receive many mansions in my Father's house
He will not be troubled or afraid
He will do greater works than I
questions.correctAnswer: He will keep my words and my Father will love him
questions.explanation: John 14:23 states that if a man loves Jesus, he will keep His words, and the Father will love him, and they will make their abode with him.

questions.question: In John 14:24, who is the source of the word that Jesus speaks?
questions.correctAnswer: The Father who sent me
questions.explanation: John 14:24 clarifies that the word Jesus speaks is not His own but the Father's who sent Him.

questions.question: What role does the Comforter, or Holy Ghost, have according to John 14:26?
options: He shall teach you all things and bring all things to your remembrance
He shall lead you to many mansions
He shall perform miracles in your name
He shall comfort only the world
questions.correctAnswer: He shall teach you all things and bring all things to your remembrance
questions.explanation: John 14:26 states that the Comforter, the Holy Ghost, will teach all things and bring to remembrance all that Jesus has said.

questions.question: What type of peace does Jesus promise in John 14:27?
options: Peace not as the world giveth
Peace like the peace of kings
questions.correctAnswer: Peace not as the world giveth
questions.explanation: John 14:27 emphasizes that Jesus leaves His peace, which is different from the peace the world gives.

questions.question: According to John 14:28, why should the disciples rejoice when Jesus says He goes to the Father?
options: Because the Father is greater than I
Because they will receive the Holy Ghost immediately
Because they will go to the mansions
Because the prince of this world is defeated
questions.correctAnswer: Because the Father is greater than I
questions.explanation: John 14:28 states the disciples should rejoice because Jesus said He goes to the Father, and the Father is greater than He.

questions.question: Who is the 'prince of this world' mentioned in John 14:30, and what is said about him?
options: The devil; he hath nothing in me
questions.correctAnswer: The devil; he hath nothing in me
questions.explanation: John 14:30 identifies the prince of this world as coming, but he has nothing in Jesus, indicating no power over Him.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'Parakletos' (Comforter) in John 14:26 mean?
questions.correctAnswer: Advocate
questions.explanation: 'Parakletos' is a Greek term meaning Advocate or Helper, referring to the Holy Ghost in John 14:26 who teaches and comforts the disciples.

questions.question: Which literary device is prominently used in John 14:6 where Jesus says, 'I am the way, the truth, and the life'?
questions.correctAnswer: Triadic parallelism
questions.explanation: John 14:6 uses triadic parallelism, a literary device where three related elements are listed together for emphasis.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage is echoed by Jesus' statement in John 14:2 about many mansions in my Father's house?
questions.correctAnswer: Psalm 23:6
questions.explanation: John 14:2's reference to the Father's house with many mansions parallels Psalm 23:6, which speaks of dwelling in the house of the Lord forever.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage connects to the promise of the Holy Ghost as Comforter in John 14:16-17?
questions.correctAnswer: Acts 1:8
questions.explanation: Acts 1:8 connects to John 14:16-17 by describing the coming of the Holy Ghost to empower the disciples as Jesus promised.

questions.question: What immediately precedes Jesus' promise about the Holy Ghost in John 14:16?
options: If ye love me, keep my commandments
I am the way, the truth, and the life
Let not your heart be troubled
questions.correctAnswer: If ye love me, keep my commandments
questions.explanation: John 14:15 immediately precedes 14:16 and contains the condition for Jesus to pray the Father to send another Comforter.

questions.question: In John 14:31, what is the purpose Jesus gives for His actions in obedience to the Father?
options: That the world may know that I love the Father
That the disciples may receive many mansions
That the prince of this world be defeated
questions.correctAnswer: That the world may know that I love the Father
questions.explanation: John 14:31 states Jesus acts according to the Father's commandment so that the world may know He loves the Father.

questions.question: How does John 14:12 foreshadow the mission of the early church after Jesus' ascension?
options: Believers will do greater works than Jesus because He goes to the Father
The early church will build many mansions
The disciples will live without fear and trouble
The prince of this world will have power
questions.correctAnswer: Believers will do greater works than Jesus because He goes to the Father
questions.explanation: John 14:12 foreshadows the early church's empowered ministry by stating believers will do greater works because Jesus ascends to the Father.

questions.question: What typological significance does Jesus' statement in John 14:6 ('I am the way, the truth, and the life') have in relation to Old Testament pilgrimage imagery?
options: Jesus is the ultimate path to God, fulfilling the journey to Zion
Jesus is a physical road builder like those in Exodus
Jesus replaces the temple sacrifices with a new law
Jesus only teaches about truth without action
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus is the ultimate path to God, fulfilling the journey to Zion
questions.explanation: John 14:6 typologically presents Jesus as the ultimate way, fulfilling OT pilgrimage imagery of journeying to Zion as the place of God's presence.

questions.question: True or False: According to John 14:18, Jesus promises He will leave the disciples comfortless after His departure.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: John 14:18 explicitly says Jesus will not leave the disciples comfortless; rather, He will come to them.

theological.title: John Chapter 14 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from John Chapter 14 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does John 14:6 teach about salvation?
options: Jesus is the exclusive way to the Father
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus is the exclusive way to the Father
questions.explanation: John 14:6 states Jesus is 'the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me,' teaching exclusivity in salvation through Christ alone.

questions.question: What doctrine does John 14:16 teach about sanctification?
options: The Holy Spirit indwells believers forever
The Spirit only temporarily helps believers
Believers are sanctified without the Spirit
questions.correctAnswer: The Holy Spirit indwells believers forever
questions.explanation: John 14:16 promises 'another Comforter... that he may abide with you forever,' teaching the permanent indwelling of the Holy Spirit in believers for sanctification.

questions.question: What doctrine does John 14:23 teach about God's presence in the believer?
options: God and the Son make their abode with those who love and obey Him
God is distant from disobedient believers
God dwells only in the temple
questions.correctAnswer: God and the Son make their abode with those who love and obey Him
questions.explanation: John 14:23 says the Father and Son will come and make their abode with the one who loves Jesus and keeps His word, teaching divine indwelling.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does John 14:27 specifically demonstrate?
questions.correctAnswer: Peace-giving
questions.explanation: John 14:27 states Jesus leaves His peace with believers 'not as the world giveth,' demonstrating God's attribute of being a peace-giver.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does John 14:11 specifically demonstrate?
options: Unity of the Father and Son
questions.correctAnswer: Unity of the Father and Son
questions.explanation: John 14:11 calls believers to 'Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me,' showing the unique unity between Father and Son.

questions.question: How does John 14:3 connect to the broader biblical theme of eternal life?
options: It affirms Jesus prepares a place in heaven for believers
It only refers to earthly mansions
questions.correctAnswer: It affirms Jesus prepares a place in heaven for believers
questions.explanation: John 14:3 promises Jesus goes to prepare a place so believers may be where He is, connecting to the biblical hope of eternal life with God (cf. Hebrews 11:16).

questions.question: What redemptive-historical connection does John 14:12 make regarding the work of believers?
options: Believers will do greater works because Jesus ascended to the Father
Believers are limited to Jesus' works only
questions.correctAnswer: Believers will do greater works because Jesus ascended to the Father
questions.explanation: John 14:12 states believers will do works greater than Jesus because He goes to the Father, indicating the continuation and expansion of Christ's redemptive mission.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do John 14:6 and John 14:9 teach about Christ's identity?
options: Jesus is the unique way to the Father and is the visible revelation of the Father
Jesus and the Father are separate in purpose
Jesus is less than the Father
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus is the unique way to the Father and is the visible revelation of the Father
questions.explanation: John 14:6 and 14:9 together affirm Jesus as the exclusive way to the Father and that seeing Him is seeing the Father, revealing His divine identity and unity with God.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do John 14:16 and John 14:26 teach about the Holy Spirit?
options: The Spirit permanently indwells believers and teaches them all things
The Spirit is an angelic messenger only
The Spirit's role ends after Pentecost
The Spirit is a symbol but not a person
questions.correctAnswer: The Spirit permanently indwells believers and teaches them all things
questions.explanation: John 14:16 promises the Spirit will abide forever, and 14:26 says He will teach and remind believers, teaching the Spirit's ongoing personal and teaching role.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do John 14:21 and John 14:23 teach about love and obedience?
options: Love for Christ is demonstrated by keeping His commandments, which results in the Father's and Son's abiding presence
Obedience earns salvation apart from love
The Father and Son do not dwell with believers
questions.correctAnswer: Love for Christ is demonstrated by keeping His commandments, which results in the Father's and Son's abiding presence
questions.explanation: John 14:21 links loving Christ with keeping His commandments and being loved by the Father, while 14:23 promises divine indwelling with those who love and obey Jesus.

questions.question: Sceptics claim Jesus' promise in John 14:3 is wishful thinking with no basis. What does John 14:3 actually teach?
options: Jesus will come again and receive believers to Himself to be where He is
Jesus only metaphorically prepares a place
There is no real place prepared
Believers must find their own place after death
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus will come again and receive believers to Himself to be where He is
questions.explanation: John 14:3 clearly states Jesus will return and receive believers to be with Him, affirming a real future hope rather than mere metaphor or wishful thinking.

questions.question: Sceptics argue that John 14:6 implies exclusivism that contradicts God's love. What does John 14:6 actually teach?
options: Jesus is the only way to the Father, showing the necessity of faith in Him for salvation
God loves everyone equally regardless of belief
There are many ways to God
Jesus is one of many mediators
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus is the only way to the Father, showing the necessity of faith in Him for salvation
questions.explanation: John 14:6 teaches exclusivity in salvation through Christ, emphasizing God's just and loving plan for redemption through one mediator.

questions.question: What doctrine does John 14:30 teach about spiritual opposition and Christ's victory?
options: The prince of this world comes but has nothing in Jesus, affirming Christ's victory over evil
Jesus fears the prince of this world
The prince of this world controls believers
questions.correctAnswer: The prince of this world comes but has nothing in Jesus, affirming Christ's victory over evil
questions.explanation: John 14:30 states the prince of the world has nothing in Jesus, teaching Christ's sovereign victory over Satan despite his opposition.

questions.question: What doctrine does John 14:10 teach about the relationship between Jesus and the Father?
options: Jesus and the Father indwell one another and share divine works
Jesus acts independently from the Father
The Father does not work through Jesus
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus and the Father indwell one another and share divine works
questions.explanation: John 14:10 explains Jesus is in the Father and the Father in Him, and that His works are done by the Father dwelling in Him, teaching their intimate unity.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do John 14:13 and John 14:14 teach about prayer and divine glorification?
options: Praying in Jesus' name results in answered requests that glorify the Father through the Son
God answers only some prayers randomly
Prayer is for personal gain only
questions.correctAnswer: Praying in Jesus' name results in answered requests that glorify the Father through the Son
questions.explanation: John 14:13-14 promises that whatever is asked in Jesus' name will be done so that the Father may be glorified in the Son, linking prayer and divine glorification.
